overview.text: The Rhombic Skaapsteker is a mildly venomous grass snake of southern Africa.

identification.text: Grey to brown with a pattern of rhombus (diamond) shapes on the back; yellow to white below.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: South Africa, Lesotho, Eswatini, southern Namibia and south-western Angola.

habitat.text: Moist savanna and grassland, where it hunts actively on the ground by day.

reproduction.text: Lays eggs that are already partly developed - halfway between laying eggs and giving birth.

recognise.text: Rows of diamond-shaped marks on a grey or brown back.
